data.completion_memo: Implemented the core-only worker proposal broker: it resolves frozen authority, rejects absent bindings, holds per-invocation approvals, and emits only approved invocation identities for later committed dispatch. cargo check for core and host passes.
data.description: Implement the sole worker-proposal-to-host-dispatch path: evaluate frozen authority and approval, durably stage an approved invocation and lease, dispatch through the supervised host, commit progress/evidence/outcome, and deliver only committed results to the worker. Preserve uncertain-effect state and forbid automatic replay.
data.title: M05.7 — Integrate the core invocation broker with worker and host
